inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan’s refusal to rule out immigration enforcement at polling places is itself a threat to equal participation. For people in immigrant communities, uncertainty about whether voting could expose them to enforcement can be enough to keep them away from the polls. That is not a defense of democracy or “order”; it is how fear narrows access to a fundamental right. The administration should make clear that polling places are for voting, not intimidation.
